About Ivoyant

# The team behind Koodisi

Ivoyant is a solutions and services provider for technology-led enterprise business transformation. We help enterprises use data and digital solutions to expand revenues, enhance customer relationships, improve operations, manage risks, and capitalize on market opportunities.

## Who we are

Ivoyant is led by an elite and seasoned team of technologists, strategists, and business leaders — with over 70 years of collective experience among co-founders in leveraging advanced technologies for business transformation.

Koodisi is our flagship integration platform — built from hard lessons running enterprise integrations at scale. It's the platform we wished existed: one that covers not just building workflows, but operating them in production with full visibility and control.

## Our mission

We believe integration shouldn't end at deployment. Most platforms stop at build. Production is where integrations actually live — and where they break.

Our mission is to give every enterprise the visibility, governance, and operational tools they need to run integrations reliably — at any scale, across any domain.

Culture

## How we work

01

### Challenge

We view obstacles as opportunities for growth and innovation — pushing boundaries to build what others call impossible.

02

### Intelligence

Strategic thinking and creative problem-solving guide every decision, from product architecture to customer outcomes.

03

### Agility

Speed without chaos. We move fast to deliver impactful solutions while keeping quality and reliability intact.

04

### Balance

We build sustainably — for our customers, our product, and our team. Well-being and work-life harmony are non-negotiable.
